title: SearchMaster: Grounded and Regulated Self-Play for Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.01822v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training LLM-based search agents requires high-quality search data: tasks that demand genuine multi-hop retrieval and trajectories that use search tools effectively. Existing pipelines often depend on human-written tasks, expert demonstrations, or stronger teacher models. We present SearchMaster, a self-play framework that trains a shared LLM policy from search tasks it generates, solves, and verifies in a local search environment. The key challenge is that self-generated tasks and rollouts can yield misleading signals: pseudo multi-hop questions, success-rate difficulty estimates that ignore search depth, and rollouts with excessive opening but little targeted evidence acquisition. SearchMaster addresses these failure modes with three controls. translated_title: SearchMaster：面向搜索智能体的接地化与规范化自博弈
translated_abstract: 训练基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索智能体需要高质量的搜索数据：既要包含真正需要多跳检索的任务，也要包含有效使用搜索工具的轨迹。现有的流水线通常依赖人工编写的任务、专家示范或更强的教师模型。我们提出了 SearchMaster，这是一个自博弈框架，它在本地搜索环境中，利用自身生成、求解和验证的搜索任务来训练一个共享的 LLM 策略。关键挑战在于，自生成的任务和推理轨迹可能产生误导性信号：伪多跳问题、忽略搜索深度的成功率难度估计，以及开局搜索过多但缺乏针对性证据获取的轨迹。SearchMaster 通过三个控制机制来应对这些失败模式：证据链生成器（ECG）将任务生成建立在显式的跨文档证据链之上，以减少伪多跳问题；搜索深度奖励（SDR）对任务难度进行评分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SearchMaster 提出了一个自博弈框架，通过在本地搜索环境中让模型自行生成、求解并验证搜索任务来训练 LLM 搜索智能体，并借助证据链生成器（ECG）和搜索深度奖励（SDR）等控制机制规避伪多跳问题与误导性训练信号。
en_tdlr: SearchMaster is a self-play framework that trains LLM-based search agents from tasks it generates, solves, and verifies in a local search environment, using controls such as an Evidence-Chain Generator and Search-Depth Reward to prevent misleading signals like pseudo multi-hop questions.
